metadata.dcterms:title: KNOTS AND PREONS
metadata.dcterms:creator: Finkelstein, Robert J.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: It is shown that the four quantum trefoil solitons that are described by the irreducible representations D3/2 mm′ of the quantum algebra SLq(2) (and that may be identiﬁed with the four families of elementary fermions (e, µ, τ; νeνµντ; d, s, b; u, c, t)) may be built out of three preons, chosen from two charged preons with charges (1/3,-1/3) and two neutral preons. These preons are fermions and are described by the D1/2 mm′, representation of SLq(2). There are also four bosonic preons described by the D1 mm′ and D0 00 representations of SLq(2). The knotted standard theory may be replicated at the preon level and the conjectured particles are in principle indirectly observable.
